The '''Farmer's workshop''' is the [[workshop]] used for any [[job]]s involving processing [[plant]]s or [[animal]] products. It is built from any construction material, and must be built by a [[dwarf]] with the [[Thresher|Plant processing]], [[Milker|Milking]], [[Shearer]], [[Spinner]], or [[Cheese maker|Cheese making]] [[labor]]s enabled.  [[Gelding]] also occurs at a farmer's workshop.  This is not a selectable menu option: instead, any animals that are designated to be gelded will automatically be assigned a gelding job at a farmer's workshop.

==Menu==
'''Farmer's Workshop'''

* ({{k|p}}) {{DFtext|Process Plants|7:0:1}} -  make [[thread]] from plants ([[pig tail]]s, [[rope reed]], [[flax]] plants, [[jute]] plants, [[hemp]] plants, [[cotton]] plants, [[ramie]] plants, and [[kenaf]] plants)
* ({{k|l}}) {{DFtext|Process Plants (Barrel)|7:0:1}} - with an empty [[barrel]], turn [[sweet pod]]s into [[dwarven syrup]] & [[seed]]s
* ({{k|v}}) {{DFtext|Process Plants (Vial)|7:0:1}} - with an empty [[vial]], turn [[valley herb]]s into [[golden salve]]
* ({{k|c}}) {{DFtext|Make Cheese|7:0:1}} - make [[cheese]] from any [[milk]]
* ({{k|m}}) {{DFtext|Milk Creature|7:0:1}} - with an empty [[bucket]], [[Milker|milk]] a milkable creature
* ({{k|s}}) {{DFtext|Shear Creature|7:0:1}} - shear [[wool]] from [[alpaca]]s, [[llama]]s and [[sheep]] (or tame [[troll]])
* ({{k|S}}) {{DFtext|Spin Thread|7:0:1}} - make [[thread]] from wool (see previous), or from hair from other creatures
* ({{k|b}}) {{DFtext|Process plant to bag|7:0:1}} - with an empty [[bag]], process [[quarry bush]]es into [[leaves]] and rock nuts
* ''(n/a)'' {{DFtext|Make sheet from plant|7:0:1}} - make papyrus [[sheet]]s from the [[papyrus sedge]] plant
:: If a {{DFtext|text is red|4:0:1}} then you lack the raw material to perform that task.

==Common Uses==
*Turn plants into [[thread]], for [[weaving]] at a [[loom]]. 
*Turn certain plants into [[food]] and [[extracts]]
*Harvest [[milk]] and turn it into [[cheese]].
